title: Today, Bishkek State University hosted a meeting with a graduate of the Faculty of Oriental Studies and International Relations Daniyar Nazaraliev, rector Mirlan Dyldaev and students.

blocks.text: On May 23, a meeting was held at Bishkek State University with a graduate of the Faculty of Oriental Studies and International Relations Daniyar Nazaraliev, rector Mirlan Dyldaev and students.

During the meeting, Daniyar Nazaraliev shared his memories of his student years, talked about his professional path, gave valuable advice to students, and also presented the university with an interactive smart board.

In addition, he presented the guidebook “Best of the Kyrgyz Republic”, of which he is one of the authors. The book is dedicated to the cultural, natural and tourist attractions of Kyrgyzstan and is intended to promote the country in the international arena. Today, this book is used in 34 countries of the world.
We are proud of our graduate and sincerely thank Daniyar Nazaraliev for his contribution to the development of the university, support of youth and popularization of Kyrgyzstan in the world!
